lines.en: label mollydorm30:
I knock on Molly’s door and wait for her to answer, but can’t help but notice a surprisingly familiar sound being muted as I do so.
: Molly?
: Oh, it’s just you, Sir.
: I suppose that’s fine, then.
: You may enter.
: Uhh...okay.
scene black
I turn the knob and make my way into Molly’s room, noticing that the volume has been slightly raised, but is still on the low side.
Based on what I can hear, however...
jump mollypornx
label restofmollyporn:
Molly takes a moment to put her clothes back on, once again making me turn around so I can’t watch her, and I begin to wonder how far I’m off from getting to skip that barrier in the future.

I mean, I know Molly’s been a little more open about stuff like this than most of the other girls for quite some time now, but I feel like this rejection thing might just be making her spiral into perpetual apathy.
Or something like that.
I don’t really know- nor do I care, since I’m already reaping the benefits of her sudden sexual growth.
Or disinterest.
Again, I still don’t really know.
But that doesn’t matter right now.
scene mollyporn8
What does matter is that it’s fucking cold.
: I’m starting to think that I should have [masturbate]d before coming out here to raise my body heat.
: Very funny, Sir.
: Though, I will admit that I am not feeling the cold just yet. So perhaps your idea isn’t too bad in the grand scheme of things.
: So, is that really all you’ve been doing lately?
scene mollyporn9
: Playing games?
: Playing those kinds of games.
: If you’re doing it to the point where it’s not even fun anymore and just a means of killing time, I can think of a lot better ways to do that.
: There are always better ways to do anything, Sir. But it doesn’t mean that anyone will actually do them.
scene mollyporn10
: Growing closer to someone inside of a setting where everything is make believe is better in every way than doing the same thing in real life.
: You don’t have to leave your chair. You don’t have to worry about what anyone thinks of you. And you can also look up a walkthrough whenever you get stuck.
: This realm does not have walkthroughs, Sir. You need to fail in order to figure out what to do next.
: But failing is painful...and closes off certain paths to you for good.
: So, if I continue to avoid that, I’ll find nothing but success in love and...sex.
: And I can also have a million girlfriends or boyfriends and none of them will get jealous of one another unless it's a major underlying theme of the games they appear in.
: Now, that definitely does sound like a plus. Except for the boyfriend thing. I don’t really need one of those.
scene mollyporn11
: See? This way of living isn’t entirely bad!
: Just...it can be a little depressing when you take the time to actually think about what’s happening.
scene mollyporn12
: You know...after seeing what Rin did to herself...and what she said to me...I couldn’t help but tear myself up over it.
: And even though I disagreed in the heat of the moment about...choosing her...I think she may have been right.
: I don’t think anything Rin said that night was “right.”
: It’s hard for someone to make any sort of argument while having their wounds held shut by someone else.
: That part...I don’t disagree with.
: What I do agree with, though, is that I didn’t have to push things further.
: I knew she didn't want me...but I tried to make her want me anyway.
: I didn’t have to start moving away from 2D out of...curiosity or interest or whatever other foul magic may have caused me to do the things I did.
: I could have stayed inside of the vessel that’s served as my escape for so long now.
: I don’t have to want someone real. But I did anyway.
: And that was a choice.
scene mollyporn13
: It was a choice...
: The wrong choice.
jump endofmollyoutsidex
label mollypornx:
scene mollyporn1
: Well, this isn’t how I expected tonight going.
: Don’t mind me. I’m just drowning my inability to form a relationship with a real person in my natural talent for romancing cartoon characters.
: I am surprised you didn’t even bother minimizing that.
: There’s no point, Sir. You already know the things I do with my spare time. And this isn’t even half as bad as the time you caught me admiring a picture of a real girl.
: So...because it’s me, you kept it open?
: I believe that is the case, aye.
: What a pleasant surprise.
scene mollyporn2
: Well, it’s not as if I could ever show something like this to the Kendo Princess.
: What if Tsuneyo is just a freak and neither one of us knows it yet?
: Unlikely, Sir. We all know by now that her only interests are noodles and that she’ll likely go the rest of her life being just as unfortunate in love as I am.
: Molly, you have been rejected one time.
scene mollyporn3
: Which is enough for me to give up entirely and simply go back to...this.
: Well, if worse comes to worst, you and Tsuneyo can always just start dating.
scene mollyporn4
: What a strange couple that would be.
: Any couple with either one of you is strange, so I imagine that one would actually be pretty normal.
scene mollyporn2
: Well, I suppose it might be nice when you put it that way.
: But, for the time being, I’d like to go back to focusing on virtual sex with virtual characters, as far away from the real world as I can possibly be.
: Well, don’t let me get in the way. It wouldn’t be the first time I’ve observed you in your natural habitat.
: I’m not planning on doing anything more than just reading in front of you this time, Sir.
: Is it because you’ve already done the fun part without me?
: Several times, actually. It’s not even enjoyable anymore, just another way to kill time.
: What a depressingly realistic answer.
: Tell me about it, Sir. I’ve all but banished myself to this realm as of late and spend my days simply wasting away behind this screen, vying for the affection and sexual attention of cartoon women.
: That just sounds like a more boring version of what I do every day.
: Well, we all have our ways of grinding.
: We sure do.
: Wow, she’s really taking it, huh?
scene mollyporn5
: You are more than welcome to read along, Sir. But I don’t particularly enjoy the thought of color commentary on h-scenes as I read them.
: Sorry. Just wanted to point out how much fun she’s having.
: I am well aware of how much fun she is having. I am the one providing the fun.
: Actually, now that you mention it, isn’t it a little weird that you’re playing a game like this from a male’s perspective?
: Aren’t there like, lesbian games you could play instead?
scene mollyporn6
: There are plenty of people who don’t take issue with playing from a different gender’s perspective, Sir.
: It is no different from how Sana plays a male Orc in Dungeons & Dragons. Or how my machinist in FFXIV is also a male.
: Okay, sure. But those aren’t games where you’re actively having sex.
: I think.
: I don’t really know what you girls get up to in that game while I’m not around.
: Are you just trying to imagine how things are from the...girl’s perspective or whatever?
scene mollyporn2
: I’m just...reading, I suppose. The perspective doesn’t matter as much as the scenario and the thought of it.
: Weird.
: Ami tells me you used to be quite fond of poetry, Sir. Is that not the same?
: As virtual sex? No, not really.
scene mollyporn1
: But aren’t you attempting to see through the eyes of someone else? And experience the things they were feeling in the moment they wrote those poems?
: I don’t know. I’ve never really thought about why I liked...or still like that stuff?...
: It’s hard to tell how I feel about anything anymore.
: Well, what I’m doing isn’t far off from that.
: It’s just...something I like.
: But if we’re going to keep talking about this and not playing the game, I suppose it might be good to put my armor back on and head outside to get some air.
: Probably a good call since you’re still beet red from masturbating to a cartoon character getting absolutely annihilated.
scene mollyporn7
: The temperature of the room must surely play some part in that, too!
: But...yes. That is likely the main reason I look this way.
: And I regret nothing! This flushness is simply a trophy of my above-average aptitude for immersing myself in media! I have nothing to be ashamed of!
: Sure, Molly.
: Sure.
scene black
jump restofmollyporn
label endofmollyoutsidex:
: If you’re looking for me to agree and say that human connections are overrated and that you should keep just fucking cartoons instead, I’m not going to.
: I...did not think you were.
: If anything, I’d say that you should drop that escape altogether and just throw yourself into reality harder than ever before.
: Go get hurt. Build up your feelings and let someone tear them down so you can get stronger and don’t feel the need to stay stuck inside for the rest of eternity.
scene mollyporn14
: But...why?
: Why?
: Yes, Sir. Why would I want to do something like that?
: I have no problem staying inside. I’ve been doing it for years.
: It’s fun...except for the times that it isn’t. And those connections with those characters feel real...except for the times they don’t.
: I don’t have a reason as to why. It’s just a thing you’re supposed to do.
: But...why?
scene mollyporn15
: If you want my selfish, sex-addicted answer...it’s because it’s always better to have someone get you off than to have to do it yourself.
: That alone should be enough to make you think, “You know what? I’m going to go talk to someone today.”
: Is it...really that good, Sir?
: Being with someone else, I mean.
: Yes.
: Why do you think it becomes a crutch for so many people? Or why it’s traded like some form of currency between men and women?
: Because...people are stupid?
: Because it has value.
: And it has value because it’s fucking awesome.
scene mollyporn16
: I see...
: You won’t “see” until you stop equating those sex game things to how you’re supposed to handle actual people.
: The reason there is no “walkthrough” for life is because every single one of us has to do something differently in order to get to the same place someone else is.
: For example, Otoha had an easier path to Rin than you did because of some choice Rin made along the way.
: In fact, it was so much easier that, even if you played your cards perfectly, the chances of you ending up with her would have been so minuscule that it would have felt like they didn’t exist.
: There’s no walkthrough because life sucks. And people suck.
: But if you keep failing and failing or whatever, you’ll eventually find some part that doesn’t suck nearly as much.
: And indulging in those moments, between when everything feels like shit, has to be better than any sort of game.
: You have...experience...right, Sir?
: I’d say too much of it, but such a thing doesn't exist.
: Can you...
: Tell me more about what it’s like?
: To...be with someone for real. And not just in a game.
: That depends on what you want to know.
: In games...it’s always romantic and...important. And characters rarely ever don’t enjoy themselves.
: But...all of those characters are designed to feel that way. They’re designed to melt at the touch of the person they love.
: Real people aren’t like that. We make mistakes and do things that other people don’t like.
: I...think I’m just worried that it won’t be what I expect...
: And that I’ll have a harder time choosing to touch a person out here than I would in there...where everything is easier.
: Well, the truth is you might.
: But that’s not something you’ll know until you try it for yourself.
: Think of it like playing a different genre of game or whatever.
: And, if you need someone to teach you how to play, I’d be down.
scene mollyporn17
: Sir!
: What?
: You want to be one of those heroines you’re always talking about, right?
: Do you really think that’s going to happen if you just stay passive like this?
: Yes! That’s how it always works in games!
: The protagonist is the one who is supposed to pursue the love interest! Not the other way around!
: Well, maybe it’s time you start thinking about yourself as a protagonist.
: It’s not like I’m going to just force myself on you and “start your route” or whatever it is you normally say.
: But, if you want to start growing up in my sense of what that means, you have a path available.
: Which is, and this isn't me trying to sound conceited, a pretty fortunate thing to have in the grand scheme of things.
scene mollyporn18
: I...don’t know...
: I’m still confused about a lot of...what I want. And what to do next.
: And I’ve also seen some pretty intense virginity scenes in games and...very few have been light on the amount of blood down there...
: They’re games, so they’re probably just exaggerating.
: But, then again, I still can’t imagine it feeling great.
: I’m just letting you know that the only choice you’re getting wrong is to keep yourself miserable instead of doing something to get out of it.
: It’s not a walkthrough or whatever, but it’s a tip from someone who’s been playing a lot longer.
: Can I at least sleep on it?
: What, you didn’t think I meant right now, did you?
scene mollyporn19
: Exhibitionism is a tag that’s dramatically increasing in popularity as years go by! It seemed very possible to me!
: I don’t know how this goes! If this were a game, we’d probably have done it when we were still in my room earlier!
: Well, I mean-
scene mollyporn20
: Uhh...no. No, not tonight.
: I need more time to prepare and...
: I’ve already.........several times...
: Yeah.
: Fine by me.
: But, if you ever decide to become the protagonist for a little while, you know what you have to do.
: Um...I still...don’t-
scene mollyporn21
: Anyway, it’s fucking cold. And if we’re ending things here, I’m probably just going to head home.
: Oh. Okay. Life continues to not give me enough tips. Excellent.
: I offered you the tip and you said no.
scene mollyporn22
: We all know it’s never just the tip, Sir!
: Sure, it might start that way, but we all know the whole thing would be bulging out of my stomach within a matter of moments!
: Unless you’re not well-endowed, which I highly doubt is the case because of your height and role as the protagonist of a dating game!
: Guess you’ll just have to wait and find out.
: Just kidding. It’s definitely big.
: I knew it.
: Anyway...goodnight, Molly.
: Have fun fingering yourself to more cartoons.
scene mollyporn23
: Yeah...okay...
: Goodnight, Sir...
scene black
I walk away from Molly without looking back at her because, right now, I’m the cool protagonist that everybody likes.
But, sooner or later, she’s going to have to take matters into her own hands.
Or just submit to the prospect that she’ll never know the touch of a real, live human and just keep holing herself up inside of her dorm.
But, if the last few days I’ve spent with Molly are any indication of where she’s headed as a person...
I think she might wind up making that choice sooner than anticipated.
